cardTitle: ML Ensemble for Time Series Classification
cardDesc: Report-backed ML case study: XGBoost reached 67.4% classification accuracy and 0.727 R2 under strict temporal validation.
title: ML Ensemble for Time Series Classification
overview: AAPL one-day-ahead forecasting pipeline with both classification (Down/Flat/Up) and regression objectives. Built from 1,488 daily observations and 133 engineered features sourced from technical indicators, fundamentals, ETFs, and macro signals, with strict temporal validation to avoid leakage.
details: Compared nine models across classification and regression with identical data and preprocessing
Strict temporal split and time-aware validation to prevent future leakage and metric inflation
XGBoost was the top performer on both tasks, with strongest Up/Down discrimination in classification
Feature engineering and ensemble methods delivered stronger performance than deeper architectures at current data scale
